proposed_widenings.name: OngoingPredicate.no_condition_active_on_any_target
proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger gate 'if the spirit has no creature Restrained' is a stateful mutex: the save only fires when no other creature is currently Restrained by this effect instance. OngoingPredicate only offers at_hp_threshold; there is no variant for 'condition not currently held on any target by this effect'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw if the spirit has no creature Restrained

proposed_widenings.name: RepeatSaveSpec.cadence.start_of_target_turn
proposed_widenings.justification: The repeat save for the Restrained target fires at the START of each of its turns. RepeatSaveSpec.cadence only supports 'end_of_target_turn' and 'on_target_takes_damage'; start-of-turn is a distinct cadence used by Conjure Elemental (and likely other hazard-area spells).
proposed_widenings.evidence: At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target repeats the save.

proposed_widenings.name: RepeatSaveSpec.onSuccess.remove_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: On a successful repeat save the target is no longer Restrained but the spell continues on that target — they can be caught again on a future turn. The only current onSuccess is 'ends_on_target' which ends the spell on the succeeding target entirely, misrepresenting this mechanic.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a successful save, the target isn't Restrained by the spirit.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.optional_flag
proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger is caster-optional: 'you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw'. Existing OngoingTrigger kinds (on_creature_enters_area, on_attached_turn_start, etc.) fire unconditionally when their event fires. There is no per-firing caster-choice flag.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.any_of (compound trigger)
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect fires on two distinct events: a creature entering the spirit's space OR a creature starting its turn within 5 feet. Modeling these as two separate operations would duplicate the save gate and the restraint predicate, creating divergent authoring. A compound 'any_of' trigger (mirroring ReactionTrigger.any_of) would express this cleanly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: enters the spirit's space or starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit

notes: Intended family is ongoing_effect with area attachment (spirit occupies a fixed point, 5-ft aura). CastTimeChoice<DamageType> for the element selection (air/lightning, earth/thunder, fire/fire, water/cold) is already in the surface. Upcast scaling (+1d8 to both damage tiers per slot above 5) would use linear_per_level with axis=slot, also already supported. The five gaps are all new variants of existing surface types (not missing v4 taxonomy atoms), so classification is surface_widening. No .dhall or .json authored — encoding would require misrepresenting the mutex predicate and repeat-save semantics.
